title: Plant Manager
text:
**PAFCO** is a $700MM+ global seafood manufacturing company with 50+ years of success. Our business is built on trust which has allowed both our company and our customers to succeed together. Learn more about the company at **www.pafco.net****.**

**Job Summary**:

The Plant Manager oversees **PAFCO**’s processing, warehousing, and distribution operations, ensuring strong performance in production, food safety, regulatory compliance, labor management, and financial results. The ideal candidate has experience in seafood or perishable food manufacturing, strong operational expertise, and proven leadership skills in a fast-paced, temperature-controlled environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversee daily seafood processing, warehousing, and distribution operations to meet production, quality, and service goals.
* Develop production schedules based on customer demand, inventory, and supply requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement to increase efficiency, reduce waste, and minimize downtime.
* Monitor production, labor, inventory, and cost KPIs to ensure operational performance.
* Oversee refrigerated and frozen warehouse operations, inventory accuracy, and outbound shipping.
* Ensure compliance with HACCP, SQF/GFSI, FSMA, FDA, USDA, OSHA, and other applicable regulations.
* Lead food safety audits, sanitation programs, corrective actions, and regulatory inspections.
* Manage equipment maintenance, facility infrastructure, and capital improvement projects.
* Own the plant budget, forecasting, cost controls, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Lead and develop supervisors, leads, and production employees across multiple shifts.
* Partner with HR on recruiting, workforce planning, performance management, and training.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, quality, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* 7–10 years of progressive plant or operations management experience in food manufacturing; seafood or perishable proteins preferred.
* Proven experience managing multi-shift operations, budgets, P&L, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* Experience with WMS, ERP, and production scheduling systems.
* HACCP certification required; SQF Practitioner or PCQI preferred.
* Working knowledge of FDA/FSMA, COOL, OSHA, and cold-chain requirements.
* Familiarity with industrial refrigeration systems and temperature-controlled operations.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and KPI-driven decision-making skills.
* Proven ability to lead, develop, and hold accountable a diverse, multi-shift workforce.
* Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively on the production floor and with senior leadership.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and operational reporting tools.
* Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field preferred.
* Equivalent combination of education and relevant operational leadership experience will be considered.

**Benefits**

* Medical insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Disability insurance
* Paid vacation leave
* 401k with employee matching

**Employment Eligibility**

* PAFCO **does not** offer sponsorship for this position
